title: Module 7: Universal Design for Learning (UDL)
description: Designing accessible learning experiences that accommodate neurodiversity and physical disabilities by providing multiple means of representation, action, and engagement.

learning_objectives.statement: Explain the three UDL pillars and how they support learner variability
Audit an instructional experience for accessibility, flexibility, and cognitive inclusion
Choose representation, expression, and engagement supports that expand access without lowering rigor

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
